note: R is NOT historical Model A. R = runs/cmb_bridge/r3/smooth_lowz_history.npz (H0 72.80). Historical Model A = runs/cmb_reconstruction/frozen/MODEL_A_FINAL.json (H0 73.21). Different artifacts, different H0, different roles. Any manuscript text using them interchangeably is an error.

R.intended_role: phenomenological distance-sector endpoint: describes what the fitted low-redshift distance sector prefers over z<=1.8

C1.intended_role: Planck-compatible reference construction (project B2/stage0 CAMB background); spectrum-level comparison established for that branch only

C2.intended_role: secondary Planck reference / pipeline sensitivity check: separately implemented stock LCDM baseline sharing the same Planck sky as C1, not an independent cosmological confirmation

historical_Model_A.intended_role: historical attempted physical realization of distance-preferred behavior (earlier early-epoch fit); fails full Planck (high-l chi2 13169.8, low-l TT non-finite); retained as audit evidence only

historical_Model_B2.intended_role: historical CMB-branch lineage from which the C1 background was obtained; ordinary LCDM with running and GR perturbations, fits Planck
historical_Model_B2.is_C1: lineage (C1 background table frozen separately as runs/cmb_bridge/r4/bare_background.npz)
